# Generated API Client & Contracts

**WARNING: DO NOT EDIT FILES IN THIS DIRECTORY BY HAND.**

## Provenance

The contents of this directory (`fnt/src/services/generated/`) are machine-generated directly from the backend FastAPI OpenAPI specification (`bck/app`).

## Rules of Engagement

1. **Machine-Generated Only**: Any file placed in this directory is the output of an automated OpenAPI contract generator.
2. **Never Hand-Edit**: Manual edits will be completely overwritten and destroyed upon the next client regeneration cycle.
3. **Regeneration Procedure**: When backend schemas or endpoint contracts in `bck/app/contracts/` change, regenerate this client using the project generation script or CLI command.
4. **Schema Changes**: If a field or type is missing or needs alteration, raise the requirement with backend contract owner (Abhiram). Do not modify generated contracts locally.
